verify_ledger.claim_text: Rosa Unsullied Blade — mana/elemental melee hero
verify_ledger.anchor_quote: Rosa 2's Level 1 Trait 'Unsullied Blade' focuses on the resource Mercury, and thanks to this, she can reach the Mystic Mercury or Realm of Mercury state.

verify_ledger.claim_text: Core skills: blade suite, Realm of Mercury elemental damage
verify_ledger.anchor_quote: The Realm of Mercury records non-Channeled Attack Elemental Hit Damage dealt to enemies and casts Mercury Baptism on all enemies within it, inflicting an Infiltration Effect of the same type as the highest recorded damage.
